faqs.question: Do Meta ads work for D2C brands in India?
faqs.answer: Yes, especially for products people discover by seeing them, such as apparel, beauty, food and home goods. They work best when tracking is correct, the catalog is clean and the margin after shipping, payment fees and returns can pay for a first order. Check unit economics before scaling spend.

faqs.question: Do I need the Conversions API if I already have the Meta pixel?
faqs.answer: Yes. Meta recommends running the Conversions API alongside the pixel. The server sends the same events as the browser, so ad blockers and browser limits lose less data. Give matching events the same event name and event ID so Meta removes duplicates received within 48 hours.

faqs.question: How do I connect Meta ads to Shopify or WooCommerce?
faqs.answer: On Shopify, install the Facebook and Instagram app and pick the Enhanced or Maximum data-sharing level, which both add the Conversions API. On WooCommerce, use Meta's official Facebook for WooCommerce plugin, which also syncs your catalog. Then check events in Events Manager and remove any duplicate pixel.

faqs.question: What is an Advantage+ sales campaign?
faqs.answer: It is Meta's automated campaign for online sales, renamed from Advantage+ shopping campaigns in February 2025. Meta handles audience, placements and budget across your ads, including catalog ads. It needs good purchase tracking and a steady supply of fresh creatives, because the ads themselves now do most of the targeting.

faqs.question: How should a D2C brand test Meta ad creatives?
faqs.answer: Test one idea at a time. Build three to five concepts, each with one reason to buy, in video and static formats. Run them in a separate testing campaign or Meta's A/B test with similar budgets, judge them on cost per purchase, move winners to the main campaign and log every result.

faqs.question: How do COD orders affect Meta ads?
faqs.answer: A COD order counts as a purchase when placed, even if it is later refused or returned to origin. That teaches Meta to find people who order but don't pay. Confirm COD orders before shipping, send a delivered or prepaid purchase signal through the Conversions API, and judge ads on delivered revenue.

faqs.question: Which attribution window should D2C brands use on Meta?
faqs.answer: The default, 7-day click and 1-day view, suits most stores. From 12 January 2026 Meta's Ads Insights API stopped returning 7-day view and 28-day view data, so older reports will not match. Compare Meta's numbers each week with orders and delivered revenue in your store.

faqs.question: How should I split my Meta ads budget?
faqs.answer: Put most of it into the main campaign running proven ads and keep a smaller, fixed share for testing new creatives. No ratio suits every brand, so set yours from your margin and how many new ads you can produce. Raise budgets in steps and include COD and returns in break-even maths.

faqs.question: What claims are not allowed in D2C ads in India?
faqs.answer: Claims you cannot prove. The ASCI Code requires truthful, substantiated ads that don't mislead by implication or omission. Meta restricts health claims and ads that assert personal attributes. India's 2023 dark patterns guidelines ban false urgency, so stock and countdown messages must be true.
